data.name: Itmam
data.gender_notes: Itmam is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 't-m-m' meaning 'to complete, to finish'. The name Itmam signifies the idea of completion or perfection in various aspects of life. The name Itmam carries the meaning “Completion, Perfection” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Itmam usually hope their child will grow to embody completion, perfection and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the journey towards spiritual perfection and enlightenment
data.etymology: Itmam belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Completion, Perfection.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Itmam total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_arabic.name: إتمام
in_arabic.long_meaning: إتمام هو اسم مشتق من الفعل 'أتم' الذي يعني إكمال الشيء أو الإنتهاء منه. في اللغة العربية، يُستخدم هذا الاسم للإشارة إلى الإنجاز أو الكمال في أي عمل أو مشروع. وفي السياق الإسلامي، يمكن أن يُرتبط هذا الاسم بأهمية الإكمال والإنتهاء من الأعمال بطريقة تامة ومقبولة عند الله.

in_urdu.name: اتمام
in_urdu.meaning: کسی کام کا مکمل ہونا یا پورا ہو جانا
in_urdu.long_meaning: اتمام ایک نام ہے جو عربی زبان کے الفعل 'أتم' سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے کسی کام کا مکمل ہونا یا پورا ہو جانا۔ اردو میں، یہ نام کسی عمل یا منصوبے کے کامیاب اختتام کو ظاہر کرنے کے لیے استعمال ہوتا ہے۔ اسلامی تقالید میں، یہ نام عمل کو مکمل کرنے اور اسے مقبول طریقے سے اختتام دینے کی اہمیت سے وابستہ ہو سکتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: इत्तमाम
in_hindi.meaning: किसी काम का पूरा होना या समाप्त होना
in_hindi.long_meaning: इत्तमाम एक नाम है जो अरबी भाषा के क्रिया 'أتم' से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है किसी काम का पूरा होना या समाप्त होना। हिंदी में, यह नाम किसी कार्य या परियोजना के सफल समापन को दर्शाने के लिए प्रयोग किया जाता है। इस्लामी परंपरा में, यह नाम कार्य को पूरा करने और उसे लोकप्रिय तरीके से समाप्त करने के महत्व से जुड़ा हो सकता है।

in_pashto.name: اتمام
in_pashto.meaning: د کار بشپړولو یا پای ته رسیدل
in_pashto.long_meaning: اتمام د 'أتم' د فعل څخه اخیستل شوی یو نوم دی، چې معنی یې د کار بشپړولو یا پای ته رسیدل دي. په پښتو کې، دا نوم د کوم کار یا پروژې د بریالي پای ته رسولو لپاره کارول کیږي. په اسلامي دود کې، دا نوم د عمل بشپړولو او په مقبول ډول پای ته رسولو اهمیت ته اړوند وي.

in_english.name: Itmam
in_english.long_meaning: Itmam is a name derived from the Arabic root 'أتم' (atamma), meaning to complete or fulfill something. In Islamic tradition, this name signifies the importance of completing tasks and actions in a manner that is pleasing to Allah. The name Itmam conveys a sense of accomplishment, wholeness, and spiritual fulfillment. Historically, names with similar roots have been used to denote perfection and completeness in various aspects of life.

data.cultural_impact: In the Islamic context, Itmam is often associated with the annual pilgrimage to Mecca known as Hajj. The term Itmam refers to the specific set of actions and rituals that must be completed on the last day of the Hajj journey, which includes standing at the plain of Arafat, offering the farewell prayer, and throwing the pebbles at the pillars of Mina. Completing these actions on the day of Itmam marks the successful completion of the pilgrimage.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Itmam emphasizes the principle of striving towards completion or perfection in one's belief and actions. In Islamic teachings, every believer is encouraged to constantly seek knowledge, rectify their character, and improve their deeds to draw closer to Allah (God). The name Itmam, therefore, serves as a reminder of the ongoing spiritual journey towards self-improvement and closeness to the divine, and the importance of completing the necessary steps towards achieving that goal.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Itmam represents completion and fulfillment in the Islamic context. It is the final step in achieving a goal, whether it be in spiritual growth or worldly pursuits. It symbolizes the realization of one's potential and the attainment of perfection.

She was known as Umm-Al-Fadl bint Harith Al-Khath'am after her marriage.
